steps.label: Text

inputs.text: a small coastal village at sunset with a lighthouse, fishing boats and seagulls

steps.note: Gemini 4 Carbon compiles the sentence into a persistent scene graph: terrain, buildings, sculpted SDF meshes and animated agents.

steps.label: 2D Video

inputs.caption: Source: a 7-second 2D clip (plays top-right, synced to the 3D scene)

steps.note: OpenCV tracks every moving object; Carbon rebuilds the scene and estimates the camera; each bird replays its tracked path in 3D.

steps.label: Plan + Photo
steps.modality: Text + site plan + photo → Taj Mahal

inputs.text: The Taj Mahal at sunrise. Serene, majestic, perfectly symmetrical.

steps.note: Plans decide WHERE things go, photos decide HOW they look. Try Plan View to compare with the drawing.

steps.label: Neon
steps.modality: Mood board → restyle the same world
steps.note: Same layout, same objects: a surgical edit of materials, lighting and atmosphere. Undo returns to marble instantly.

steps.label: Reclaimed
steps.note: Mossy marble, banyan roots on the plinth, jungle canopy, parakeets: one image, the whole world re-themed.

steps.label: Lava Forge
steps.modality: Mood board → forged from a volcano
steps.note: Black basalt and molten channels. Press R to ride along with the birds, V for first-person.
